verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never mentions an official Open WebUI SDK in any language. What it does show is adjacent: API keys that let external code call the same endpoints as the web UI, an OpenAI-compatible gateway that any OpenAI-style client can use, and a Python plugin system. None of these is a first-party SDK, and the probe found no published OpenAPI spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
